title: Multi-source Transfer Learning of Time Series with a Shapelet-based Distance Measure
abstract: arXiv:2609.15148v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transfer learning is an effective technique for addressing data scarcity in deep learning for time series classification, but its success depends on the selection of source datasets. Conventional transferability estimation methods are often computationally expensive, as they require fully pre-training a model on each potential source dataset to assess its suitability. This paper introduces a novel, training-free source selection method named Shapelet Matching. Our approach first identifies discriminative shapelets from the target and potential source datasets. Then, Shapelet Matching quantifies dataset similarity by comparing the extracted sets of shapelets. To mitigate the risk of negative transfer from selecting an unsuitable single source, we introduce a multi-source transfer learning method. translated_title: 基于Shapelet距离度量的时间序列多源迁移学习
translated_abstract: 迁移学习是解决时间序列分类深度学习中数据稀缺问题的有效技术，但其成功取决于源数据集的选择。传统的可迁移性估计方法通常计算成本高昂，因为它们需要在每个潜在源数据集上完整预训练一个模型以评估其适用性。本文提出了一种新颖的免训练源选择方法，称为Shapelet匹配（Shapelet Matching）。我们的方法首先从目标数据集和潜在源数据集中识别出具有判别性的shapelet，然后通过比较提取出的shapelet集合来量化数据集之间的相似性。为了降低选择不合适的单一源数据集所带来的负迁移风险，我们进一步引入了一种多源迁移学习方法：根据基于shapelet的相似度分数选择多个源数据集，将它们合并为一个多源数据集，并使用该数据集进行迁移学习。
tldr: 本文提出了一种免训练的Shapelet Matching源数据集选择方法，通过比较shapelet集合量化数据集相似性，并结合基于相似度的多源数据集融合策略来降低负迁移风险。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a training-free source selection method called Shapelet Matching that quantifies dataset similarity by comparing discriminative shapelet sets, and introduces a multi-source transfer learning approach that combines multiple similar source datasets to mitigate negative transfer.
